items.title: Hunayn ibn Ishaq on His Galen Translations
items.note: New edition and English translation of Ḥunayn's Risāla, the master list of Galen titles in Syriac and Arabic; the link is to a JAOS review.

items.title: Continuing research on the Syriac Galen Palimpsest: collaborative implementation within the framework of two European projects
items.who: N. Afif, C. Arsene, S. Bhayro et al.
items.note: Reports progress in imaging, transcribing and aligning the Syriac On Simple Drugs undertext with the Greek and Arabic witnesses.

items.title: Galeni In Hippocratis Epidemiarum librum II commentariorum I–VI versio Arabica
items.note: Edits Ḥunayn's Arabic version of Galen's commentary on Epidemics II, whose Greek original is lost.

items.title: Galen in Syriac: Rethinking Old Assumptions
items.note: Challenges the view that sixth-century Syriac translations of Galen were poor, arguing that Syriac witnesses deserve weight in reconstructing lost and damaged texts.

items.title: The Galen Palimpsest and the Modest Ambitions of the Digital Data Set
items.note: Describes the openly licensed digital data set of Syriac Galen Palimpsest images and metadata, released by the Walters and expanded as new leaves were imaged.

items.title: The Syriac Galen Palimpsest: A Tale of Two Texts
items.who: N. Afif, S. Bhayro, G. Kessel et al.
items.note: Describes the imaging, codicology and recovered content of the palimpsest and its value for the Greek text.

items.title: X-ray fluorescence imaging of a Syriac Galen Palimpsest leaf at SLAC
items.who: SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory and University of Manchester
items.note: Synchrotron X-ray imaging recovered undertext of the sixth-century Syriac On Simple Drugs on leaves that multispectral imaging could not fully read.

items.title: Brill's Companion to the Reception of Galen
items.note: Includes surveys of Galen in Syriac (Bhayro), Ḥunayn's Arabic Galen (Cooper) and Hebrew Galen (Caballero-Navas), mapping where translated witnesses survive.

items.title: A Literary History of Medicine: The ʿUyūn al-anbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-aṭibbāʾ of Ibn Abī Uṣaybiʿah
items.who: E. Savage-Smith, S. Swain and G. J. van Gelder (eds.)
items.note: Critical edition and translation of the biographical dictionary whose Galen entry lists works and preserves quotations.

items.title: The Syriac Text of Book Nine of On Simple Drugs: New Evidence from the Syriac Galen Palimpsest
items.who: N. Afif, P. E. Pormann, W. I. Sellers et al.
items.note: Uses a lemmatised Greek–Syriac corpus with image analysis to reconstruct the Syriac and propose readings for the Greek.

items.title: Galen and the Arabic Reception of Plato's Timaeus
items.note: Studies Galen's role in the Arabic reception of the Timaeus, including his compendium of the dialogue that survives only in Arabic.

items.title: New Fragments of a Commentary on the Oath Attributed to Galen
items.venue: Hippocratic Commentaries in the Greek, Latin, Syriac and Arabic Traditions (Brill)
items.note: Publishes newly identified fragments of the Oath commentary attributed to Galen, a work lost in Greek and previously known from Arabic quotations.

items.title: Galeni In Hippocratis Epidemiarum librum VI commentariorum I–VIII versio Arabica
items.note: Edits the Arabic translation, the only complete witness to a commentary of which roughly a third is lost in Greek.

items.title: Dioscorides and Galen in the Syriac Tradition: A Reconsideration of Three Passages About Herbs in an Anonymous Syriac Pharmacological Book
items.note: Identifies unacknowledged parallels to Galen's On Simple Drugs in an anonymous Syriac pharmacological book, showing Galenic text embedded in later compilations.

items.title: Galeni In Hippocratis De aere aquis locis commentariorum I–IV versio Arabica
items.note: First critical edition of the Arabic version of Galen's commentary on Airs, Waters, Places, which is lost in Greek.

items.title: Translation into Syriac, Arabic, and Hebrew
items.note: Current survey of the Syriac, Arabic and Hebrew transmission and of works preserved only in translation.

items.title: Galen, On Demonstration
items.note: Reconstructs the lost On Demonstration from Greek and Arabic fragments, with a chapter on its Arabic transmission, translation and interpretation.

items.title: Syriac Galen Palimpsest Processed Images
items.who: P. E. Pormann, W. Sellers, S. Bhayro, N. Afif and N. Smelova
items.note: Releases processed images (about 67 GB) with a first digital critical edition of books 6–9 of Sergius's Syriac On Simple Drugs.

items.title: New Considerations on the Manuscript Thessalonicensis Vlatadon 14
items.note: Reassesses the manuscript that yielded On Avoiding Distress, the main recent case of a lost Galenic work recovered in Greek.

items.title: GESIUS: Gesius' Commentaries on Galen: Recovering lost works through a mixed-method approach
items.note: Funded project, begun April 2026, to image and transcribe five palimpsests holding Syriac versions of Gesius's lost commentaries on Galen's Mixtures and Natural Faculties.
